eligibility_ug.general_rule: Candidates must have passed 10+2 / Higher Secondary Examination with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/Computer Science.
eligibility_ug.minimum_marks: Minimum 60% aggregate marks (55% for reserved category SC/ST/OBC students) in standard 12th board examinations.

eligibility_pg.general_rule: Bachelor's degree in relevant discipline (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc) from a recognized university.
eligibility_pg.minimum_marks: Minimum 55% aggregate or CGPA of 6.0 on a 10-point scale.

application_steps: Step 1: Register online on the official admissions portal (admissions.example-college-portal.edu).
Step 2: Fill in academic details and upload 10th/12th grade marksheets, entrance test scorecard, and ID proof.
Step 3: Pay the non-refundable application fee of ₹1,200 via online net banking/UPI.
Step 4: Check published merit lists and counseling call letters on the portal.
Step 5: Attend in-person document verification at the Admissions Office and confirm provisional seat allotment.
admissions.reservation_policy: Reservations strictly adhere to state government educational norms: SC (15%), ST (7.5%), OBC-NCL (27%), EWS (10%), and Persons with Disability PwD (5% horizontal reservation).

courses.description: Comprehensive curriculum covering Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Computing, Distributed Systems, and Full-Stack Engineering.
Specialized degree focusing on Machine Learning architectures, Deep Learning, Big Data pipelines, and Natural Language Processing.
Focuses on VLSI design, Embedded Systems, IoT architecture, and Wireless Communications.
Blend of traditional thermo-mechanical design with robotics, automation, and 3D additive manufacturing.
Postgraduate leadership program in Business Analytics, Financial Markets, Marketing, and Operations.
Advanced research-oriented master's degree in High-Performance Computing and Intelligent Systems.

fee_structure.payment_mode: Online ERP portal via Net Banking, Debit/Credit Cards, or NEFT/RTGS challan.
fee_structure.transport_bus_fee: ₹22,000 to ₹34,000 per year depending on route distance zone.
fee_structure.fee_payment_schedule: Semester fees are payable in two installments: Odd Semester by July 31st; Even Semester by January 15th. A grace period of 7 days is provided, after which late fee of ₹100/day applies.
fee_structure.fee_refund_policy: As per UGC guidelines: 100% refund if withdrawn 15 days before commencement; 90% within 15 days before; 80% within 15 days after; 50% between 16 and 30 days; 0% beyond 30 days after session commencement.

examinations_and_academics.curriculum_structure: Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) with semester pattern (8 semesters for B.Tech, 4 for MBA/M.Tech).
examinations_and_academics.attendance_requirement: Mandatory minimum 75% attendance in each registered subject to be eligible to sit for End-Semester Examinations. Medical exemption up to 65% is considered upon Dean approval with verified hospital records.

evaluation_breakdown.internal_continuous_assessment: 40% (2 Mid-term tests, surprise quizzes, laboratory practicals, and assignments)

examinations_and_academics.passing_criteria: Minimum 40% in End-Semester written examination and 50% combined (internal + external) to clear a course.
examinations_and_academics.backlog_and_revaluation_rules: Supplementary / Backlog examinations are scheduled alongside regular semester exams. Students can apply for photo-copy inspection and revaluation within 15 calendar days of result declaration via the examination portal for ₹500 per subject.

placements_and_internships.internship_opportunities: Mandatory 8-week summer internship between 6th and 7th semester. College Training & Placement Cell provides on-campus internship drives with stipends ranging from ₹15,000 to ₹60,000 per month.
placements_and_internships.training_cell_initiatives: Comprehensive soft skills, competitive programming, mock technical interviews, and resume review workshops provided free of charge to all enrolled students.

scholarships.name: Chairman's Merit Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.benefit: 50% to 100% tuition fee waiver for top 20 rank holders in national/state entrance tests.
scholarships.eligibility: Rank within top 2,000 in State CET or 95+ percentile in JEE Main.

scholarships.name: Dean's Academic Honor Concession
scholarships.benefit: 25% tuition fee waiver for subsequent academic year.
scholarships.eligibility: Students securing CGPA 9.2 and above in university semester exams.

scholarships.name: Economically Weaker Section (EWS) Support Scheme
scholarships.benefit: Up to 40% tuition fee subsidy + book bank support.
scholarships.eligibility: Annual family income verified below ₹3,00,000 with satisfactory academic record.

scholarships.name: Women in STEM Advancement Grant
scholarships.benefit: ₹25,000 annual scholarship incentive for female engineering students.
scholarships.eligibility: Top 15 enrolled female candidates based on merit.

scholarships.name: National & State Government Scholarships
scholarships.benefit: Post-Matric Scholarships for SC/ST/OBC and Minority students as disbursed directly by government welfare departments.
scholarships.eligibility: Subject to state government portal application deadlines (usually September 30).

hostel.capacity: Separate secure residential hostels for 900 Boys and 650 Girls on campus.
hostel.amenities: 24/7 Security CCTV, Biometric attendance, High-speed Wi-Fi, Gym, Indoor games room, Solar water heaters.
hostel.curfew_rules: Hostel gates close strictly at 8:30 PM for all students. Weekend night-outs require warden approval and written parent consent.

transport.coverage: Servicing Metro Central, North Railway Station, Suburbs, and Outer Ring Road.
transport.tracking: Live bus location tracking available on the student mobile portal.

sports_and_recreation.facilities: Floodlit basketball courts, FIFA-standard football ground, cricket turf pitch, 4 badminton courts, gymnasium with certified trainers, and table tennis arena.

cafeteria_and_medical.health_centre: 24/7 Campus Medical Clinic with resident physician, qualified nurses, basic pharmacy, and dedicated emergency ambulance on call.
